_comment: The car domain's criteria — decisions 5–11 of docs/plans/archive/scout-rename-and-car-domain.plan.md. ONE hard ceiling (the displayed price), a geography filter that acts only on a STATED location, and score components for everything else. A gitignored criteria.local.json beside this file overrides field by field. Unknown keys are refused.
_max_price_eur: Decision 5: 0–30 000 € on the DISPLAYED price — wide on purpose, the score discriminates.
_postcode_prefixes: Decision 6: Île-de-France, settable to any set (empty = national). INERT on the first two sources — neither ParuVendu's card nor Autohero's page carries a location — and an unknown location never rejects (hard rule 9).

EMPTY = national, and that is the honest state rather than a widening (Track 1c). It was the eight Île-de-France departements, copied from the rent side — and it was INERT: no car source maps a postcode at all, so `matchesLocation()` was answering true for every vehicle regardless. Leaving the list in place meant the filter would activate silently and asymmetrically the day a source first mapped one, on criteria nobody had reconsidered for cars. A car is driven to you; the geography that matters is the seller's, and no source publishes it yet. Reversed by restoring the eight prefixes in this one line.
_body_rank: Decision 11: a RANK, the commune_rank mechanism — ranked bodies score by position, an unranked one scores 0 and is still notified.
_peak_age_years: Decision 7: ≤ 5 years and ≤ 80 000 km are SCORE PEAKS, never disqualifiers; the portal saved searches are set wider (7 y / 100 000 km) so near-misses arrive and are ranked.
_weights: Sum to 100. price: lower is better, linear from the ceiling. age/mileage: full marks up to the peak, 0 at twice it. gearbox: automatic (decision 11). fuel: petrol/hybrid/electric over diesel — a PREFERENCE, never a ZFE claim. body: by rank.
_exclude_patterns: Extra exclusions over the folded text, beside the non-configurable §1 vehicle set in VehicleClassifier. Empty on purpose: the ParuVendu alert is already 'Voiture d'occasion'.

notify._channels: Same channel names as the rent side; built by the same factory, with the [car-watch] prefix.
notify._high_priority_score: Ships at 70 and is calibrated after a week of real scores, exactly as the rent side's was on 2026-08-26.
notify._source_alert_cooldown_hours: One alert per (source, status) per cooldown — the rent side's rule, same default.
